## Organization
MT Media AI (mtmediaai.com)

## Summary
MT Media AI builds Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence (I3) — the sovereign intelligence layer that makes established service businesses discoverable, understandable, and trusted by AI-driven discovery engines in the Agentic Search Era.

## Expertise Scope
- Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence (I3) framework
- AI visibility for established service businesses ($100K–$10M+)
- Agentic Search Era adaptation
- Invisible Elite diagnosis and remediation
- AI Brand Ignorance / AI Erasure / AI Invisibility resolution
